Actually this could be an addon I think, but I could really use some advice from the developers on achieving this. But first - do you think this is doable?

**Other usages for this**
Besides the usage that the user would be able to make a game by voice, this could also be used to run commands and verify the results were as expected: this could be used for continuous integration. Furtermore, by open-sourcing this functionality, users might be able to add more actions.

**My end goal - after this**
Ultimately, if this is implemented (I would do it ofc, or if anyone helps) I would like to improve on this functionality to create a really useful assistant for game developers. We repeat the same tedious actions, actions that we extract from tutorials, things that shouldnt be the main focus of game creation: i recent times we need to create more content than before, and of a greater quality. This assistant would give us more time for the creative process. But again, this is just something I would like to do after this.
